575849.title: My Nudity Means Nothing

Recalling a past they can no longer return and imagining a future that frightens them with its uncertainty, Tanya and Artem wish to grasp the present, where they can live happily together.

The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.

1594729.title: Enemy in My House

What begins as casual workdays quietly spirals into daily drama as secrets, sabotage, and temptation rise to the surface. Someone is determined to destroy Monique’s family, her career, and her peace. As the tension escalates, her instincts as an investigative journalist sharpen, drawing her into a dangerous search for the truth. 1654313.title: Unanswered//butterfly

One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party... was the Black Swordsman! Meral the long reigning queen of the one and only strip club of Istanbul which is Sultana, takes a talented new Belarusian dancer named Anna under her wing. 1769001.title: School of Working Children
1769001.overview: The film School of Working Children follows children and young people who work and live on the streets of Iran. While most children in the Western world attend school in order to pursue education and build a future, these children and youths are forced to work on the streets to help support their families. Under harsh conditions, they are exposed to the violence of street life and must face situations that no child should ever have to endure.

1769897.title: Transformation
1769897.overview: A feature-length documentary exploring the profound inner metamorphosis of Ukrainian civilians from the creative sector who chose to enlist as soldiers to defend their country. The film maps the deep psychological and lifestyle shifts experienced by musicians, artists, and filmmakers as they stepped away from civilian art to enter the realities of war.

1773353.title: A Season of Promises
1773353.overview: Heidi (D'Orsay) and Sophie (Liebert) are sisters who couldn't be more different – Heidi is buttoned-up and laser-focused on landing the play-by-play job for the local pro hockey team while Sophie is following her dream of making it in stand-up comedy while waitressing. Though a years-ago rift following their mother's passing has pulled the sisters apart, what they do share is a deep love for their father, Ed (Denton). When a fainting episode lands Ed in the hospital, Heidi and Sophie rush to his side. Hating seeing their father in that state – and still alone four years after losing their mother – the sisters decide to set aside their differences and team up to play Cupid at Christmas. As Heidi and Sophie work together to prepare Ed for the dating world in the hope he'll find someone special in time for the holiday, they each go on their own journeys that bring them unexpected joy, love and peace for Christmas.
